facts.fact: Egypt's National Health Strategy 2024-2030 names a unified electronic medical record among its key actions: hospitals of all service providers are to be automated to align with it, and operational systems are to automate all primary care units in governorates inside and outside Universal Health Insurance to support it, measured by the percentage of automated units and of compliance with the record; these are planned actions with no figure of present use, and the document gives no date, so the published date is used.

The National Health Strategy 2024-2030 lists the Ministry of Health and Population as key implementer in the action table that carries the unified electronic medical record and the automation of hospitals and primary care units to support it; the passage's table is flattened in extraction, so the pairing of implementer to action is read from position, and the document gives no date, so the published date is used.

note: Passages only, with the action tables flattened. Everything on the EMR is a planned action; the document states no present tier, point of entry or clinic count, so there are governance facts alone. The health information system is named but its description is cut off after 'handles a multitude of indicators', so it is left unclassed and gives no hmis fact. The 70-80% hospital automation figure does not say it holds the clinical record, so it is not an emr fact.
